notes.subject: l/7489 'to his own hurt'
notes.rationale: להרע either 'swears to hurt himself (and keeps it)' or 'swears to do evil (to another)'; I follow the first, oath to one's own disadvantage.

notes.subject: נשבע 'to seven oneself'
notes.rationale: Hebrew verb for swearing is built on 'seven'; rendered simply 'swirim' (swear).

notes.subject: נבזה … נמאס
notes.rationale: Two near-synonymous verbs 'despised … spurned' compressed into 'liklik tru na bagarap'.

translation: Long ai bilong em, man i nogut em i liklik tru na em i bagarap, tasol ⟨את⟩ ol man i scare long Yahwe em i givim nem gut long ol; em i swirim sapos samting nogut i kamap long em, na em i no senis.
